The project developed an analysis of the state of Zacatecas to identify the infrastructure needed to reach sustainable development at the regional level. CAPSUS conducted an analysis of the existing infrastructure and demographic and economic trends of the state, and then, using this information, the team developed a set of recommendations for investments to improve the environmental, social, and economic development of the state.
